QUESTIONS.q: HOT TAKE: TRUE or FALSE — Summer happens because Earth is closest to the Sun.
QUESTIONS.a: FALSE — seasons come from Earth's tilted axis
QUESTIONS.fact: Earth is actually closest to the Sun in early January, during the Northern Hemisphere's winter.

QUESTIONS.q: How tall is Borah Peak, Idaho's highest mountain, in feet?
QUESTIONS.fact: Borah Peak is in the Lost River Range. The 1983 earthquake lifted it about a foot higher.

QUESTIONS.q: HOT TAKE: Which is more dangerous to people near a volcano: lava flows or pyroclastic flows?
QUESTIONS.fact: Pyroclastic flows are avalanches of hot gas, ash, and rock that race downhill far faster than anyone can run. Most lava flows move slowly enough to walk away from.

QUESTIONS.q: BLITZ: Name Earth's 4 main layers from the center out. GO!
QUESTIONS.a: Inner core, outer core, mantle, crust
QUESTIONS.fact: The crust is so thin compared to the whole planet that it's like the skin on an apple.

QUESTIONS.q: What is the hardest mineral on the Mohs scale, and what number is it?
QUESTIONS.fact: The Mohs scale runs from talc (1) to diamond (10). Each mineral scratches the ones below it.

QUESTIONS.q: HOT TAKE: TRUE or FALSE — Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
QUESTIONS.fact: Lightning often hits the same tall object again and again. The Empire State Building is struck about 20 to 25 times a year.

QUESTIONS.q: About how much of Earth's surface is covered by ocean?
QUESTIONS.fact: The world ocean holds about 97% of all of Earth's water.

QUESTIONS.q: BLITZ: Name the 3 types of plate boundaries. GO!
QUESTIONS.fact: Plates pull apart at divergent boundaries, collide at convergent boundaries, and slide past each other at transform boundaries like the San Andreas Fault.

QUESTIONS.q: HOT TAKE: Which formed first in Idaho: the granite of the Idaho Batholith or the basalt of Craters of the Moon?
QUESTIONS.fact: The batholith granite is tens of millions of years old. Craters of the Moon's last eruptions were only about 2,000 years ago.

QUESTIONS.q: What gas makes up about 78% of the air you breathe?
QUESTIONS.fact: Oxygen is about 21%. Argon, carbon dioxide, and other gases make up the last 1%.

QUESTIONS.q: BLITZ: Name the 3 main rock types AND one example of each. GO!
QUESTIONS.a: Igneous (granite, basalt), sedimentary (sandstone, limestone), metamorphic (marble, slate)
QUESTIONS.fact: The rock cycle turns any one of these rock types into the others over time.

QUESTIONS.q: HOT TAKE: Is Pluto a planet?
QUESTIONS.fact: In 2006 astronomers reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet because it hasn't cleared its orbit of other Kuiper Belt objects.
Scientists dated meteorites and Moon rocks to find Earth's age.

QUESTIONS.q: HOT TAKE: TRUE or FALSE — The Sun is a star.
QUESTIONS.fact: The Sun is a medium-sized, middle-aged main-sequence star powered by nuclear fusion.

QUESTIONS.q: BLITZ: Name the 4 Earth spheres. GO!
QUESTIONS.fact: Every Earth event, like a volcanic eruption, touches all four spheres.
